title: Postcard and Orchard
author: Wren Dravenmoor
blurb: Wendell Iversen, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
